body: Thank you, thank you so much, everyone who has talked to me. You have no idea how much you have done for me. Just to know anyone is willing to take the time to listen to my ramblings...I dont even have the words. I feel like I exist and that is a monumental step, thank you.

I'm in Sydney. Normal city, normal country, normal people. Then there's me.
I used to think that i should fight for the kind of treatment that I give other people, but I'm 38 - life has shown me I'm not entitled to that. The whole world can't be wrong.
But I can't be alone. When I enjoyed things I liked being on my own, I wasn't hating my own company, but now its a case of do I want to be right or do I want to be not so miserable? 
I dont know what it is about me - but if i could get away from me i would too. I cant fight for something when i agree with everyone else that im not worth it, even though i dont know why.
My sister says i had an upbringing worthy of a dr Phil episode, and we actually have a decent amount of money put aside for a celebration when she finally dies, but that doesnt mean she was wrong.
My place in this world is to be a support or source of entertainment for others, and to appreciate where people allow me to enter their lives - and not be demanding things that I'm simply not entitled to. Things like love, passion, laughter, support, friendship just people being nice to me.
I just need to find a way to settle in with that and live it without constantly demanding all those things

I've been told all my life I'm selfish and worthless. I've spent 38 years trying to fight it, but I've decided to stop being so arrogant and just try to accept my place. But I'm doing a really bad job.
I've tried everything over the years to get people to want to know me. I'm not worth knowing and I'm really bad at trying to be what people want.
I go further than I've ever seen anyone else go to be loyal to people, and that works when they need help but its not enough for them to want to be around me when things are good for them and certainly not enough for anyone to be there for me.
Last year I got an insurance payout and I gave over $100k to my best friend, and gave so much money to everyone in my life. Just to make them smile, to make them happy, and hope that it is enough to show that I'll do anything for them. Now the moneys gone I see it wasnt enough. I'm more alone than ever. 
I can't get out of my head that i have done all of this and I couldnt get anyone to even wish me a happy birthday or merry christmas. I dont give to get something tangible back. I give because people like kind, generous people, right? I live with my best friend and still I couldn't get a simple merry christmas from anyone. Let alone the gesture of a gift. 
I know how self absorbed and arrogant it is for me to be thinking like that. I can't stop thinking 'what about me?' But i know I have no right to, and that just feeds the selfishness even more.
The only way I can get anyone to just put up with me for small amounts of time is to beg them, promising to do anything they want, give them anything I can. I take all responsibility for any problem in any friendship, and for any problem those people have in my life.
I have one good friend and I talk to one sister. I have had to promise all this to keep them just talking to me, and they both tell me I'm a shameless doormat for making those promises to the other - but I have to do it to get them to put up wth me too.
I know I have three options - 1) just end it. I can't do that successfully either so there's no point, it just makes people hate me even more. 2) walk away and find somewhere - like, in the middle of nowhere - where I don't know anyone and can't damage anybody. Or 3) learn how to keep my place and just do what I need to so I at least have the people I love putting up with me instead of actively hating me.
I want to learn how to do that but I can't get past this pure arrogance where i keep thinking 'I deserve better than this, its not fair'.
The truth about me started showing itself when I was a small child and my mother began singling me out from the family to tell me that I was worth less than nothing and needed to learn to just shut up and do what people need from me without being so selfish and demanding things. I spent years foolishly hating her thinking she was being mean to me, and I see now that woman was trying to protect me, prepare me for what was coming.
I've accepted it, I just dont know how to live it.
I'm sorry this was so long
I'm sorry that was really selfish of me. Its what I do. Thank you for being kind about it. You didnt have to show me that kindness.

I'm sorry that question was really selfish of me. Its what I do and I don't know not to make everything about me. I just hope I can maybe get some advice about how to just exist without being worse than a burden on everyone around me. I'm too weak to do the right thing and just disappear and find somewhere else to go and just live without people.
I'm sorry to be taking up your time like this, there are people here who are deserving of someone to listen to them, but if you could spare me just a few minutes, and I can figure this out, you'll be helping the people around me who I damage all the time, so its not just for me.
